characters.name: Trollet
characters.description: Eieren av slottet som truer inntrengerne, men blir lurt til å se sola og sprekker.
characters.look: A colossal old troll about four times a man's height, round-shouldered and heavy, covered all over in long, matted, oatmeal-beige fur like a giant unshorn ram, with heather and twigs caught in it. He has little round ears, great grey hands like stone, a long cow's tail with a tuft at the end and broad, hairy bare feet.

characters.name: Prinsessa
